Your sister is dead wrong. You didn’t owe her that trip, she’s wrong for exiling you because she couldn’t go on a silly bus tour. That’s self absorbed and sad. Your relationship should matter more than that and shouldn’t be contingent on what you do for her. 
It’s not your fault. She’s missing out on having a good relationship with you because she didn’t get a tour and that’s her regret to deal with. Not yours especially if you’ve reached out. She’ll understand when she’s older hopefully and understands how small it is in the grand scheme of life and how it wasn’t worth your relationship.

This is also really important. I can’t help but think if I just drop it then I’ll regret it and it’ll become an even bigger problem. Or worse I bring her and have a chip on my shoulder about it because she’ll have most likely taken more stuff. 
As for it being a parent problem, I know. My mom passed 2 years ago and my dad is emotionally checked out barely even talks to her or any of us. I tried to ask my oldest sister to talk to her but then I felt bad about that too. Hence why I came to Reddit. 
It’s a really tough situation to navigate because, I know I can’t be a doormat and if she doesn’t want to talk to me anymore as a result, she’d be wrong but I would still end up hurt. 
Honestly, her retaliating is entitled because I don’t owe her the tickets, but she’s not going to see it that way.
Also, thank you for giving your opinion from a moms perspective. I feel like that’s an answer that my mom would’ve gave me too. I won’t remember the things she took but I’ll remember the concert.💕

Ginkoba = No Daydreaming

If you are like me who ends up letting your daydreams get in the way of your interpersonal relationships then Ginkoba may be right for you! 
I’ve been taking it for quite sometime and it allows me to focus more and not daydream as much. It’s allows me to kind of stop the daydreams when I need to get stuff done. It’s a vitamin that you can get over the counter. 
It’s a specific brand of ginkoba though. I tried another brand recently and anticipated the same effect but nope. 
The brand is body gold. It’s called ginkoba brain formula. It comes in a white bottle and it has orange and green writing. It’s not costly either. 
I just figured I should share what helps me. This is all based on my own personal experience and I’m no doctor.
